Before you start

Read the module README first. This section is the author's, not the archive's, and the builder uses this array verbatim (SF-10b).

Your first class

A class is a name plus the state and behaviour filed under it. Start with the smallest one that compiles.

  1. Declare the class.
  2. Give it one method.
  3. Write the test before the body.

A method you cannot name is a method you do not yet understand.

  • Name it.
  • Then write it.

Problem statement

Make Greeter.greet return Hello, <who> for any non-empty name.

Show a hint

Concatenation is enough. The grader shipped with the material checks the exact string.

Lesson: Your first class

The test class shipped with the material is the grader. It is authoritative because nobody here wrote it (R5).
